official.domain-heading: Real GFTV sites all end with globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia one
official.domain-body: Read the address from the back, at the last dot before the first single slash. If end with something else, confirm not GFTV, even if the name got appear earlier in the address.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) is Asia's biggest furry fandom news channel, based in Singapore one.
about.body-2: We show how the furries grow, so everyone today and tomorrow can appreciate, and we open spaces so people can learn about each other and understand each other.
about.body-3: From home we reach the big continents, so GFTV's team very international, multicultural and multilingual one.
